svg.title: CoreMark/MHz estimates: HaDes-V+ vs upstream CVA6 (simulation)
svg.desc: Horizontal bars, one per run, in two panels by flag set (-O2, and CVA6's CI flags) on one scale. Colour marks the core; every bar carries its value and its memory setup. Simulation estimates, not CoreMark scores. docs/PERFORMANCE.md has every value in a table.
svg.text: CoreMark/MHz in simulation: HaDes-V+ vs upstream CVA6, same CoreMark, GCC 12.2.0, 10 iterations
Estimates from cycle counts of simulated RTL, not CoreMark scores (no 10-second run). Clock speed and area are not part of this figure.
-O2, the flags of HaDes-V+'s CoreMark flow
